exposure: Low glucose-Dulbecco's Modified Eagle's Medium (L-DMEM) only (control)
outcome: Differentiation of hUMSCs into neuron-like cells
Expression of glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP)
cohort: The study utilized human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells (hUMSCs) obtained from human umbilical cords of full-term caesarean section patients.
finding: Tetramethylpyrazine (TMP) effectively induced human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells (hUMSCs) to differentiate into neuron-like cells, with the optimal concentration of 4.67 mg/ml resulting in positive expression of NSE and NF-H but negative GFAP.
mod_finding: Human umbilical cord-derived mesenchymal stem cells (hUMSCs) were sourced from human umbilical cords obtained from full-term caesarean section patients.
